name: codex-pro-dispatch
description: A fail-closed macOS desktop workflow for dispatching bounded work from Codex or Claude Code to a dedicated ChatGPT conversation.

interface.longDescription: Desktop-only on the official ChatGPT app for macOS. Dispatch bounded work from Codex or Claude Code to dedicated ChatGPT conversations with at-most-one sends, collect-only recovery, and up to two configured workers.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this bounded task to my ChatGPT worker.
Ask my ChatGPT worker for an independent code review.
Recover my current dispatch without resending.
